P_calibration.quote: Pending enforcement is likely preserved by 1 U.S.C. § 109, but the drafters did not include a savings clause.

P_grandfather_step.quote: Sec. 3(b)/Sec. 8 — licensing rush and a 180-day gap. The grandfather date is enactment, but the prohibition does not bite until 180 days later (Sec. 8).
